regions.merged_text: Many thanks for your kind favor just Rec'd, noted. I am sending you the Cert. for Helen Mayland. I think she needs it especially from your letter. In the mean time and till I get up a little better with my correspondence, best regards and God holy blessing to all the others - your dear Father especially. I do hope with you, that with the warmer Spring his health and spirits bloom up again and that things in general pick up in his favor. I almost forgot to congratulate you on your February suc- cess, etc. Deo gratias. Please pardon haste and brevity. Hope for improvement in future.
